correctness.rationale: For continuous positive T-periodic environmental forcing w and strictly interior T-periodic orbit (x,r) of Jiang et al. Eq.(9), with a,b payoff symbols A=rP_N−1,B=r_d Q_N>0, differentiate H=−log(1−x)+[epsilon(beta−alpha)]^(−1)log((r−alpha)/(beta−r)). The A terms cancel and dot H=B[theta−(1+theta)x], hence over a full period E(xB)/E(B)=theta/(1+theta) for every N>=2. When N=2, Q_2=x/2 even at w=1, hence E x²=theta/(1+theta)E x and Var x=bar x(theta/(1+theta)−bar x); for nonconstant x the unweighted mean is strictly less than the static equilibrium. At N=2 theta=r_d=1, alpha=3/2,beta=9/5,epsilon=12,w=1+eta cos t, unforced equilibrium (1/2,5/3) has Jacobian [[1/12,3/16],[-8/45,-1/10]], trace −1/60, determinant 1/40. Its period map is locally invertible in initial state, giving an attracting interior analytic periodic branch. First harmonic from (iI−J)z=(5/48,−1/18) gives |z_x|²=625/54772; time-shift eta→−eta gives even mean, so bar x=1/2−(625/54772)eta²+O(eta⁴). Independently rederived symbolic Jacobian and amplitude. The exact identity, not bounded shooting, establishes unbounded parameter claim.
